lines.text: Many learners say: My house is near of the park.
Better: My house is near the park.
Near has no of after it.
Near! The bank is near the station.

data.wrong: My house is near of the park.
data.right: My house is near the park.
data.why: Near has no of after it.

native.tip: En español “cerca de”, pero en inglés “near” va sin “of”: “near the park.”
